_note: CV selection end to end on alanine dipeptide in water: end-state runs, a basin model over a nine-candidate pool, targeted MD both ways, shots that stop on entering a basin, and likelihood maximization. Run from a directory holding system/, base.namd, pool.json, published.json and ends/e0..e7.conf (see thalweg/README.md). About five minutes on 24 cores.

steps.tool: cv_select.py classifier --cv {pool} --psf {psf} --closed ends/e0.dcd ends/e1.dcd ends/e2.dcd ends/e3.dcd --open ends/e4.dcd ends/e5.dcd ends/e6.dcd ends/e7.dcd --skip 50 --max-wrong 0.05 --out classifier.json

cv_select.py tmd --psf {psf} --coor system/beta.coor --target-psf {psf} --target-coor system/alphaR.coor --sel "{heavy}" --runs 3 --steps 10000 --dcdfreq 100 --final-rmsd 0.1 --seed 31000 --namd-base base.namd --out tmd_b2a

cv_select.py tmd --psf {psf} --coor system/alphaR.coor --target-psf {psf} --target-coor system/beta.coor --sel "{heavy}" --runs 3 --steps 10000 --dcdfreq 100 --final-rmsd 0.1 --seed 32000 --namd-base base.namd --out tmd_a2b

cv_select.py shots --psf {psf} --dcd tmd_b2a/tmd0?.dcd tmd_a2b/tmd0?.dcd --n 180 --per-config 2 --steps 2500 --chunk 50 --dcdfreq 2500 --classifier classifier.json --label pool_label.pdb --cvinp pool_cv.inp --namd-base base.namd --out shots
